governance: Sealed-set discipline: the packet is assembled, hashed and frozen BEFORE any annotator call. Labels remain machine-adjudicated SILVER, never human gold.

generation.selection_rule: deterministic: sort unused doc ids (excluding the 15 dev-visible blind_packet docs), take the first 15 with >= 40 sentences and 5 causal_questions each; all 5 role-conditioned questions per doc are included
generation.freeze_artifact: runs/c2ges_stage3/sealed_packet.jsonl (same schema as blind_packet.jsonl: doc_id, title, source_url, sentences[{sid,text}], questions[{qid,role,question}]) + sealed_manifest.json (per-doc sha256 + set-level sha256, custodian='annotation-pipeline', no-leakage declaration)

annotation.resolution: v1.2 two-tier rule unchanged (Tier-1 deterministic: subset_minimal / intersection_consensus; Tier-2 adjudicator C on substantive conflicts)
annotation.models_and_params: unchanged (A=DeepSeek, B=Gemini, C=gpt-5.4 via Cloubic; temperature 0; max_tokens 1024)
annotation.validation_gate: not required (v1.2 already gated on dev set); C-timeout technical retries allowed up to 2 per item, unresolved recorded

metrics: v1.2 metric set; sealed results reported separately from the dev-visible 75
